working_title: The Boötes Void: Universe's Longest Silence

script.hook: Imagine a hole in space so vast, it could hold 2,000 Milky Ways... but it's almost empty!
script.body_1: This is the Boötes Void, a super-sphere 330 million light-years wide.
script.body_2: Where thousands of galaxies should exist, astronomers found only sixty.
script.conclusion: If our galaxy was in the center, we wouldn't have known other galaxies existed until the 1960s!
